verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for a DevSecOps platform like GitLab, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry, usage-data or service-ping opt-out. The ability to turn the Agent Platform on or off is an adjacent feature toggle, not a telemetry control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
